metadata.task: Go to the study room, retrieve the laptop charger, and place it on the desk.

plan.goal: Navigate to the study room (bedroom_3), pick up the laptop charger, and place it on the study desk.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate from the current location to the study room (bedroom_3).
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at an unspecified initial location within the Apartment environment.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has successfully reached the study room (bedroom_3) and is positioned at a valid approach pose near the study desk.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill NAV_015 allows navigation to a named room. Although the robot lacks explicit indoor navigation capabilities (can_navigate: False), the planner assumes the existence of a semantic map and a basic navigation stack (MoveIt2/Nav2) capable of executing the movement to the specified room pose, which is a prerequisite for any manipulation task.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Detect the laptop charger in the study room and estimate its pose.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is located in the study room (bedroom_3).
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has detected the 'laptop charger' object and estimated its 3D pose relative to the camera frame.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill PER_001 detects objects in sensor data. This is required to locate the 'laptop charger'.
Skill PER_009 estimates the 3D pose of a detected object, which is necessary for the subsequent pick action.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Move the arm to a reaching pose above the laptop charger.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is in the study room and knows the pose of the laptop charger.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot arm is positioned at a safe, reachable pose above the laptop charger, ready to grasp.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_005 moves the manipulator to a target pose. This is used to position the arm for grasping.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot arm is positioned above the laptop charger.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has successfully grasped the laptop charger.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_003 closes the end effector to secure the object. This is the core manipulation step.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Move the laptop charger to the desk in the study room.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the laptop charger in the study room.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot arm is positioned above the desk surface, ready to place the object.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_005 moves the arm to the target pose (on the desk) to prepare for placement.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the laptop charger on the desk.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the laptop charger and positioned above the desk.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has released the laptop charger on the desk.

grounded_skills.reason: Skill MAN_002 places the held object at the target pose (the desk).

constraints: Robot is fixed-base (cannot navigate physically). Navigation relies on a simulated or teleoperated path to the room pose.
Robot lacks visual perception (no cameras). Object detection and pose estimation rely on assumed sensor data availability or pre-existing semantic maps.
Robot has limited payload. Laptop charger weight must be within limits.
